title: Statement Tax Disbursement on Retention Statements
content:
**Statement tax disbursement — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction.** On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the statement tax disbursement enters the retention statement balance. It is figured from the set-aside held under the Set-Aside Accounts product that pays the loan's property charges.

**Clause.** The statement tax disbursement is the statement bill of type property tax bill limited to the set-aside's set-aside balance when that set-aside is a Fully Funded LESA, and that bill in full when it is a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, whose shortfall source pays any part above its balance at once as a corporate advance; a loan with no such bill or no such set-aside carries nothing (0.00).

**Statement bills.** A statement bill is, for each of property tax bill, hazard insurance bill and flood insurance bill, the received bill of that type with the latest due date on the set-aside that pays the loan's property charges, an active Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory), an active Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) or an active Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, when its payment date falls no later than 30 calendar days after the statement date; a bill's payment date is its due date less the set-aside plan's tax payment lead days for a tax bill and less its insurance payment lead days for a hazard or flood bill. Where several such bills of one type share that latest due date, their billed amounts are taken together as that type's bill. The 30 days are the plan's good-through period.

| Set-aside paying the property charges | Tax statement bill present | Statement tax disbursement |
|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory or Borrower-Elected) | yes | the bill, limited to the set-aside balance |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | yes | the bill in full |
| either | no | nothing |
| none of these | — | nothing |

*Hypothetical:* a Fully Funded LESA holding USD 800.00 with a tax statement bill of USD 1100.00 gives USD 800.00; the same bill on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve gives USD 1100.00.
